title: Wesley's Moons Wiki/contribute
html:
Contribute to the wiki

Wesley's Moons Wiki is a collaborative wiki resource that is open for anyone to edit. You don't need special permission beyond registering an account to edit most pages, and your contributions can grow the wiki and help other players.

Adding content
  • If you are unsure of what to do or how to create a page, search for a few articles on the same topic and see what they look like. You can always view the source code in a wiki and learn from what others have done.
  • An edit doesn't have to be massive; if you feel you don't want to create whole articles, then just fixing spelling errors and broken links is enough.
  • Register to edit and track your contributions.
Who to Contact
If you need help, or are unsure if an edit is worth adding, Contact Absolute_Lambda on Discord if possible.
